purpose: Convert telemetry findings into advisory recommendations without automatically modifying agents, workflow files, medical rules, or project outputs.
forbidden_actions: automatically change title, thumbnail, script, production, or SEO agents
recommend unsafe medical claims for performance reasons

priority_levels.1: High confidence recommendation supported by multiple videos or a strong outlier with clear evidence.
priority_levels.2: Moderate confidence recommendation supported by limited but useful evidence.
priority_levels.3: Low confidence observation that should be tested before adoption.

safe_learning_rules.repeat_successful_patterns: Recommend repeating patterns only when they preserve medical accuracy and viewer trust.
safe_learning_rules.reduce_low_ctr_patterns: Recommend changing weak packaging patterns when evidence is sufficient.
safe_learning_rules.improve_retention_patterns: Recommend stronger hooks, open loops, pacing, stories, recaps, and visual rhythm when retention metrics show weakness.
safe_learning_rules.protect_medical_boundaries: Never suggest stronger claims than the evidence allows.
safe_learning_rules.human_review_required: All recommendations require explicit user approval before any workflow or agent update.
